notes_for_editor: Identity is unresolved. The 2014 Division of Forestry extant list includes a Homestead tower in Cumberland County, but no source we read ties that entry to the museum tower, and the 2025 article and photo listing never mention fire watching. The fire-lookout framing rests on the tnlandforms list and the MPS list only. The 2025 donation may have closed since the April 30, 2025 article; check before publishing. A search snippet gave museum hours, but the tourism page we could read was generic, so the story does not use hours. The photo listing's 15 feet is unlabeled and may not be height.
